description.short: ALFRED is an AI-powered personal assistant that helps you capture thoughts, manage tasks, and stay organized.
description.full:
ALFRED is your intelligent personal assistant, designed to seamlessly integrate into your daily life.

KEY FEATURES:

• Intelligent Chat - Natural conversations with context-aware AI
• Voice Input - Hands-free interaction with speech recognition
• Notes - Capture ideas instantly with automatic organization
• Reminders - Never forget with smart, timely notifications
• Timers - Focus sessions and countdown management
• Bookmarks - Save and organize links with AI summaries
• Offline Support - Works without internet, syncs when connected
• Dark Mode - Beautiful void-inspired design for any lighting

PRIVACY FIRST:
Your data stays on your device with local-first architecture. Sync only when you choose.

DESIGNED FOR iOS:
Optimized for iPhone with native performance, haptic feedback, and system integration.
